set: B: one sheet across each acting state

reads.read: calm and curious: it drops into the form, drifts to the Email field and hesitates there, then moves up to First name, which lights orange, so it is about to start filling the form
reads.meant: Confident: upright, a slight bounce, a strut.
reads.verdict: did not read: calm, curious and hesitating, not confident

reads.read: startled, then hurt: a fireball hits it by the W key and leaves a smoking hole in it; it spins and tumbles, steadies itself, then flees up the keyboard as more fireballs come
reads.meant: Shocked: a double take; it stretches tall and snaps back.

reads.read: panicked and frantic: still smoking, it darts and zigzags around the keyboard dodging fireballs, with smeared motion trails
reads.meant: Nervous: beads of sweat form and roll off, a small tremble, a gulp that travels down its body.
reads.verdict: did not read: panic, not nerves; the sweat, the tremble and the gulp are not in the read

reads.read: wary, then cornered: while it weaves between keys, big red 'Invalid email' slabs slam down around it; it backs away and slips out toward the filled Email field
reads.meant: Scared: it goes pale and stony, leans back, hides behind the nearest field.
reads.verdict: did not read: wary, not scared; pale, the lean back and the hiding are not in the read

reads.read: shaken but relieved: scorched and smoking, it escapes the keyboard into open space, finds a Resume sheet and carries it up toward the form
reads.meant: Proud: it puffs up and dusts itself off.
reads.verdict: did not read: shaken and relieved, not proud

reads.read: determined and straining: it hauls the resume into the drop zone, but a black cable is wrapped around it and seems to tug it back
reads.meant: Angry, in the tug: the tip glows red and it vents steam, pulling against the shredder with its two arms.
reads.verdict: did not read: the arms read as a cable wrapped round it, the shredder is not in the read, and the feeling is determined, not angry

reads.read: stunned, then crushed: next to a shredder that has just cut the resume to strips, it shakes in a blur, steadies, then wilts and collapses into a limp, crumpled heap; it has given up
reads.meant: Exhausted: it sags and melts a little at the edges, drags itself, slumps against things.

issues.where: bottom row, all three frames, the collapsed arrow under the shredder
issues.what: the crumpled heap loses the arrow silhouette completely. At a glance it reads as a mushroom or a small ghost, not a defeated cursor, so you cannot tell it is the same character
issues.fix: keep the arrow's tip and the notch of its tail readable while it slumps: bend it at the waist, lay the tip on the floor and let the tail droop, and do not melt it into a blob

issues.where: row 1, frames 1-2, the moment the fireball hits by the W key
issues.what: no squash or flinch on impact. The arrow stays rigid and only tilts afterwards, so the hit lands without weight
issues.fix: add 1-2 frames where it compresses along its length and bends away from the hit, then a stretched recoil before the spin

issues.where: rows 1-3, when the red 'Invalid email' slabs drop next to the arrow
issues.what: it does not react to the slabs. It keeps the same upright pose and slides on like a pointer, so the threat does not register
issues.fix: add a startle (jump back and stretch) when each slab lands, a cower or squash as the next one comes down, and a hold before it slips away

issues.where: rows 2-3, the six frames parked by the Email label, and the move to First name in row 4
issues.what: the arrow drifts and parks with an identical pose. There is no anticipation before it heads to First name and no posture change while it hesitates, so it reads as a plain pointer
issues.fix: give the hesitation a lean or tilt toward the field, add a small pull-back before it darts up to First name, and stretch it during the move

issues.where: all frames, the arrow tethered by the black cable
issues.what: the arrow just translates and rotates slightly while it is supposedly hauling against the cable. There is no strain, bend or lean, so the effort and the tug of the cable do not read
issues.fix: lean it hard away from the pull, stretch it along the cable and add a snap-back squash when the cable jerks it

issues.where: arrow scale compared with set-B-07.png and set-B-02.png
issues.what: the arrow is much larger in B-06 than in B-07, which weakens continuity from sheet to sheet
issues.fix: keep the arrow's screen size within a narrow range between beats, or justify the change with a clear camera push
issues.builder: Not acted on: the tug is filmed with a push in (kit/02: the camera pushes in for that beat); the sheet does not show the push itself.

issues.what: the dodging is repetitive, with the same slide-and-tilt each time. The panic is held, but nothing escalates
issues.fix: vary it with one near miss that makes it squash and duck, and one stretched leap

issues.what: did not read: confident reads as calm, curious and hesitating.
issues.fix: An upright strut with a bounce in every step and a decided move to the field; no parking beside Email.

issues.what: did not read: nervous reads as panic; the sweat, the tremble and the gulp do not show at sheet size.
issues.fix: A held nervous beat in clear space: the beads large enough to see and rolling off, the gulp travelling down the body, before it moves on.

issues.what: did not read: scared reads as wary; it does not go pale and stony, lean back or hide behind a field.
issues.fix: After the dive it tucks behind the nearest field's rim, leaning back, pale, and holds there while the next slab comes.

issues.what: did not read: proud reads as shaken and relieved.
issues.fix: The puff up and the dusting off, held beside the resume, before the carry; the smoke of the hit cleared by then.

issues.what: did not read: the arms read as a black cable wrapped round the arrow, the shredder is not in the read, and angry reads as determined.
issues.fix: Two separate arms from the two shoulders to two hands on the sheet, the shredder in every frame of the sheet, the red tip and the steam of anger visible.
